result.stdout:
Usage: dotnetarium <project.csproj|solution.sln|solution.slnx> [options]
  --sarif <path>             Write SARIF 2.1.0
  --config <path>            Override dotnetarium.json (version 2.0)
  --analysis-profile <fast|full|max> Override the configured profile; explicit numeric limits remain in effect
  --fail                     Return 1 when findings are present
  --respect-editorconfig     Apply configured rule severity and suppression
  --verify-secrets           Check supported credentials online (opt-in)
  --config-include <glob>    Include matching config files (repeatable)
  --config-exclude <glob>    Exclude matching config files (repeatable)
  -p, --project             Use MSBuild design-time loading instead of the default no-build loader
  --configuration <name>     Select configuration (default: Debug)
  --framework <net8.0|net10.0> Select root target framework
  -h, --help                 Show this help
